description.value:
One end of this heavy cylinder of steel has been forged in the likeness of a dragon turtle's head, the mouth gaping wide. Grips at the opposite end allow one to hold and aim this heavy cannon-like barrel with both hands. As long as you're carrying dragon turtle artillery while you're on a boat or ship, the DC for any effect to capsize that vehicle increases by 4.

Activate—Turtle's Tsunami 2 (concentrate, manipulate, water)

Frequency once per day

Effect A @Template[cone|distance:50] of surging water blasts from the mouth of the cannon, dealing @Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage|traits:concentrate,manipulate,water] damage to creatures in its area of effect (@Check[reflex|dc:27|showDC:all|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:prone|traits:concentrate,manipulate,water] save). A creature that fails its save is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone].
